translation.name: Colombia
translation.summary: Colombia connects Cartagena and the Caribbean coast with Bogotá, Medellín, the Andes, the coffee-growing region and national parks. Ada Tours can arrange a journey through its cities and natural landscapes, add time at the beach or combine Colombia with neighbouring South American countries.

translation.bestTime: April, October and November are among the rainiest months; weather varies considerably by altitude and region.

featureBands.title: Medellín and its surroundings
featureBands.text: Combine Medellín with city walks, museums, the Botanical Garden and outings into the surrounding mountains. Its climate and Andean setting make it a good base for several days.

featureBands.title: Colombian cities beyond the postcard
featureBands.text: In Bogotá, Cartagena and other major cities, explore neighbourhood markets, crafts, local produce and everyday life alongside architecture and museums.

featureBands.title: A culinary journey through Colombia
featureBands.text: The coffee region, markets and regional cooking can make food a central part of your route. Ingredients and dishes change with the climate and with coastal and Andean traditions.

translation.body:
Colombia is ideal for a longer itinerary combining cities, the Andes, the Caribbean Sea and tropical landscapes. Begin in Bogotá with La Candelaria, the Gold Museum and views from Monserrate, then continue to Zipaquirá and Lake Guatavita.

Cartagena offers colonial architecture, Caribbean coastline, restaurants and evening life. From here, add the Rosario Islands and beach days. Further north, explore Santa Marta and the natural areas of the coast, including treks towards the Lost City.

Medellín and the coffee region reveal inland Colombia. Include city museums and works associated with Botero, green valleys, coffee estates and hiking routes through the Andes. National parks, volcanic regions and trekking are options for a more active programme.

Ada Tours can organise a complete journey through Colombia or include the country in a wider South American itinerary. Cities, wildlife, coffee, beaches, diving and active days can all be combined into one trip.
